paper.$description: Paper — Page backgrounds, light cards, navigation surfaces, and white text on graphite panels

ink.$description: Ink — Display headings, primary text, logo marks, dark page bands, and high-contrast icons

graphite.$description: Graphite — Dark cards, code panels, dark utility buttons, and contained product demonstrations

cloud.$description: Cloud — Muted section surfaces and pale technical-card backgrounds

steel.$description: Steel — Hairline separators, diagram outlines, and subdued borders

slate.$description: Slate — Navigation labels, long-form supporting copy, inactive tabs, and secondary icons

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Emphasized body copy and dense explanatory labels

aqua-relay.$description: Aqua Relay — Filled conversion buttons, selected use-case markers, and small product-diagram highlights — the cool signal that makes a workflow feel live

lime-notice.$description: Lime Notice — Full-width announcement strips and occasional lightweight promotional controls — a broad highlighter wash above the restrained header

volt-lime.$description: Volt Lime — Developer-oriented filled buttons and compact product highlights

signal-sweep.$description: Signal Sweep — Rare horizontal technical accent for connector lines and illustrated signal paths

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

neo-grotesk-medium.$description: Display and section headlines. The -0.04em tracking and 0.8 line-height at 80px deliberately pack words into a dense payment-infrastructure voice rather than a spacious editorial headline.

neo-grotesk-bold.$description: Occasional compact 32px feature headings requiring a firmer silhouette than the Medium display face.

inter.$description: Navigation, buttons, labels, body copy, and large testimonial copy. At 14px it stays compact and firm; at 32px it serves as a softer, lower-contrast quote treatment on dark panels.

chivo-mono.$description: Technical metadata, code-adjacent labels, and small implementation details.

kode-mono.$description: Code samples and microscopic diagram annotations, introducing an explicitly technical layer beneath the grotesk marketing typography.
